components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A conventional primary action outside the Quick Reels edge rail.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--reels-accent); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--reels-accent); color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; font: 650 11px/1.3 var(--reels-ui); transition: background 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--reels-accent-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--reels-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet drawer or form action used when an icon-only edge action would be ambiguous.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--reels-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--reels-sheet); color: var(--reels-ink); cursor: pointer; font: 650 11px/1.3 var(--reels-ui); transition: background 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--reels-raised); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--reels-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Two-option feed-order switch with a quiet active fill.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; min-height: 34px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--reels-raised); } .ds-segmented button { min-height: 28px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--reels-muted); font: 600 12px/1.3 var(--reels-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button.is-active { background: var(--reels-sheet); color: var(--reels-ink); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--reels-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Unit Filter Button
components.description: A three-column unit filter row with a marker, title, and source count.
components.css: .ds-unit-filter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px; width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--reels-muted); font: 400 12px/1.3 var(--reels-ui); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-unit-filter.is-active { background: var(--reels-active); color: var(--reels-ink); } .ds-unit-filter:hover { background: var(--reels-raised); } .ds-unit-filter:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--reels-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-unit-filter span:first-child { font-weight: 650; } .ds-unit-filter span:last-child { color: var(--reels-faint); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-reading-card { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; overflow: hidden; background: var(--reels-sheet); color: var(--reels-ink); font-family: var(--reels-ui); } .ds-reading-card header { padding: 18px 22px 8px; color: var(--reels-accent); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-reading-card > div { overflow-y: auto; padding: 9px 96px 16px 24px; } .ds-reading-card h2 { margin: 0 0 15px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 600 28px/1.06 var(--reels-display); letter-spacing: -0.022em; } .ds-reading-card p { margin: 0; font: 400 16px/1.38 var(--reels-display); } .ds-reading-card footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 90px 13px 18px; } .ds-reading-card a { color: var(--reels-muted); font-size: 11px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-reading-card a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--reels-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Reel Action Rail
components.description: Four icon-first study actions at the lower-right edge, with separate previous and next chevrons below.
components.css: .ds-reel-actions { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 104px; display: grid; gap: 9px; } .ds-reel-actions button, .ds-reel-actions a { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--reels-ink); color: var(--reels-sheet); cursor: pointer; } .ds-reel-actions [aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--reels-accent); } .ds-reel-actions button:focus-visible, .ds-reel-actions a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--reels-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Link
components.description: The persistent route from a generated card back to its exact note heading.
components.html: Open the exact source section
components.css: .ds-source-link { color: var(--reels-muted); font: 400 11px/1.3 var(--reels-ui); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-source-link:hover { color: var(--reels-accent); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-source-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--reels-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Range Control
components.description: A labelled slider for speech rate or visual-card music volume.

components.name: Progress Track
components.description: A thin, non-decorative progress fill tied to completed source sections.
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 100%; height: 4px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--reels-rule); } .ds-progress span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--reels-accent); transition: width 180ms ease-out; }

components.name: Modal Drawer
components.description: The feed-controls drawer at every viewport size. It uses modal-dialog semantics, traps focus, and returns focus to its trigger on every close path.
components.html: <aside class="ds-modal-drawer" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Quick Reels controls"><button type="button" aria-label="Close feed controls"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/></svg></button><button type="button">Unit order</button></aside>
components.css: .ds-modal-drawer { position: fixed; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: min(88vw, 360px); background: var(--reels-chrome); color: var(--reels-ink); box-shadow: 18px 0 48px rgba(15,23,42,0.14); } .ds-modal-drawer button { min-height: 44px; } .ds-modal-drawer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--reels-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Scroll Cue
components.description: A visible fallback shown only when one indivisible source passage is taller than the card body.
components.html: Scroll inside this card for more
components.css: .ds-scroll-cue { margin: -2px 0 7px; color: var(--reels-accent); font: 650 11px/1.3 var(--reels-ui); text-align: right; } .ds-scroll-cue[hidden] { display: none; }

narrative.overview:
Worst Generation is a study system, not a content feed. Its visual identity comes from the exam paper: exact source prose, a quiet reading surface, and the learner's own progress always within reach. The interface stays quiet enough that the note text remains the loudest thing in the room.

The system combines two related voices. The main site uses Newsreader for editorial headings, system sans for controls, restrained subject colour, and familiar study-document structure. Quick Reels borrows the spatial grammar of a vertical reel—one centred portrait frame, a calm surround, a restrained edge action rail—without borrowing social metrics, autoplay, or decorative video overlays. It remains an exam reading tool.

Depth is functional. Most surfaces sit flat and separate through tone and a hairline edge. The Quick Reels frame and controls drawer receive directional shadow because they physically float above the stage. The only saturated colour is the subject blue, and its rarity keeps progress, active controls, and source context findable.
keyCharacteristics: Source text is the dominant visual element.
One blue accent marks action, position, and active state.
One centred reel frame replaces a permanent dashboard shell.
Edge actions stay icon-first, labelled, and keyboard-operable.
Semantic overflow keeps source boundaries intact and uses an explicit scroll fallback only when needed.
Controls use true modal-dialog semantics at every viewport size, and status changes use separate live regions.
Light and dark themes change values, never hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Chroma Rule
rules.body: A subject colour marks action, selection, and progress. It does not tint every surface, decorate the frame, or compete with source content.

rules.name: The Reel Stage Rule
rules.body: Quick Reels keeps one portrait study frame centred in a quiet surround. It borrows the composition of a vertical reel, not its social furniture: no fake metrics, comments, follower counts, autoplay, or decorative overlays.

rules.name: The Source Voice Rule
rules.body: Source headings and educational passages use Newsreader. Interface labels use the sans. Never use monospace to make ordinary labels feel technical.

rules.name: The Measured Scale Rule
rules.body: A reading stage exposes a clear jump from source heading to body. Do not fill the gap with intermediate decorative sizes.

rules.name: The Source Boundary Rule
rules.body: Overflow splits only at sentence, list-item, code-line, or table-row boundaries, and retains every source word. If one indivisible atom cannot fit, keep it intact inside a scrollable body and show a visible scroll cue.

rules.name: The Modal Focus Rule
rules.body: The controls drawer behaves as a true modal at every viewport size: background content is inert, focus stays inside, and every close path returns focus to the trigger.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface can be separated with tone, it is flat. Shadow is a response to physical layering, not a default finish.

dos: Do keep the current source heading, answer label, exact-source access, and position visible while reading.
Do use Newsreader for source prose and the sans for controls.
Do separate surfaces with tone and a hairline before reaching for shadow.
Do keep every control keyboard-operable with a visible focus state and accessible name.
Do use one subject accent to mark action, selection, and progress.
Do preserve the exact source text and split overflow only at semantic boundaries.
Do show a visible cue when an indivisible passage requires card-body scrolling.
Do keep secondary controls in the modal drawer rather than rebuilding a permanent dashboard shell.
Do keep the controls drawer modal and restore focus to its trigger on every close path.
donts: Don't copy Instagram literally. Use the reel composition, not fake likes, comments, follower counts, messaging bubbles, autoplay, or decorative social chrome.
Don't rewrite, summarise, reorder, or silently omit source teaching content.
Don't use decorative gradients, glows, glass, icon tiles, or a second accent palette.
Don't let edge actions cover prose, tables, or diagrams.
Don't use monospace for ordinary labels; reserve it for code, diagrams, seeds, and measurements.
Don't hide the transcript or make audio the only way to access a card.
Don't hijack modified browser shortcuts or suppress native controls while they have focus.
Don't add persistent motion, moving content, or autoplay without an explicit user action.
